statements.statement: The service was a 48-hour Holter monitoring study
The patient has a history of recurrent palpitations consistent with supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1)
The patient has episodes of dizziness (R42)
The patient had a recent syncopal event (R55)
The monitoring was ordered to correlate symptomatic episodes with potential arrhythmic activity and guide further management
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
